name: Single Taxpayers' Registry (RUC) number
issuer: the National Superintendence of Customs and Tax Administration (SUNAT)
note: Peru's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: the Single Taxpayers' Registry (RUC) under Legislative Decree 943 is administered by SUNAT (the National Superintendence of Customs and Tax Administration); those who become taxpayers, seek certain refunds, use customs regimes or deal with the public administration must register, in person or online (RUC Digital for domiciled natural persons with a National Identity Document, DNI); the RUC is 11 digits, for individuals with a DNI the prefix 10, the DNI and a verification digit (rule not given, `check` left out). Read as given on application, to anyone who must register. No age, fee or time is stated.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Peru: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: the administration of that registry is in charge of National Superintendence of Customs and Tax Administration (SUNAT). Must register in the RUC those who: a) To acquire the status of taxpayers ... RUC consists of an 11-digit number. The number is structured as follows: (a) Individuals identified with DNI: Prefix 10 + DNI + verification digit.
